contributionMap.claim: The coordinatewise clause of Conjecture 3.1 fails: on the house graph at eps=1/2 the roof score has pi_0=638/3615, pi_1=22/125, pi_inf=8/45; exact cubic roof response; monotone iff eps<=eps_c~0.2406813; one strict minimum otherwise, at mu=1 iff eps=4/9; endpoint shortcut wrong iff eps>eps_0~0.3291038.

limitationTriage.limitation: Census certified only at five damping values (and orders 2-7); behaviour between those eps values not certified.
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Can a certified sweep over eps (bivariate root isolation in (mu, eps)) or an order-8 census be run cheaply?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: Census at five values; symbolic bivariate treatment done for the house, gem, paw, P3 and diamond
limitationTriage.estimatedCost: days of new code and multi-hour computation (order 8: nauty enumeration of ~11k graphs)
limitationTriage.reasonOpen: Requires bivariate certified root isolation or a much larger exact computation; listed as open problem 4

limitationTriage.limitation: No proof assistant: covers, the period-class argument and the asymptotic statements are proved in prose only.
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Would a Lean/Isabelle formalisation of the house certificate and Theorem 9.1 be cheap?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: Exact identities machine-checked by the verifier; prose proofs audited adversarially
limitationTriage.reasonOpen: Formalisation of Markov-chain resolvents and asymptotics is a separate project

limitationTriage.limitation: Journal wording of Conjectures 3.1-3.2 unverified (paywall); arXiv v2 checked verbatim.
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Can the journal full text be obtained through an open route?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: ScienceDirect (HTTP 403) at novelty search and review; Crossref metadata confirmed
limitationTriage.estimatedCost: depends on access; no cheap open route found
limitationTriage.reasonOpen: No legitimate access to the publisher text was available

limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Does local weak convergence of configuration models (Garavaglia et al.) plus the local formula for pi_inf give the transfer?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: Heuristic via size-biased neighbour degrees; tail transfer proved for the limit variable Z; one-sided bound proved
limitationTriage.reasonOpen: Graph-level local convergence of the radius-two functional under precise model and degree hypotheses is not proved; research-level

limitationTriage.limitation: Prevalence, excursion, shortcut and ranking statistics numerical; exact grid searches certify nothing between grid points.
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Could the standard-network results be certified by the census method?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: One exact reversal certificate (Proposition 10.1); numerical study labelled
limitationTriage.estimatedCost: high: degree-2m interpolation for m in the hundreds
limitationTriage.reasonOpen: Exact interpolation at degree 2m for networks with hundreds of edges is impractical with the present method

limitationTriage.limitation: No structural classification of graphs or vertices with monotone coordinates.
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Is there a structural class (trees were the candidate) with all coordinates monotone?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: Census includes all trees on <=7 vertices at five eps; the post-revision audit found a five-vertex tree counterexample (now Proposition 5.5), so trees are not such a class

limitationTriage.limitation: Minimality with leaves (order four) was stated without its damping qualification.
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Is P4 monotone for every eps, which with the paw classification gives the exact smallest order with leaves?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: Exact symbolic P4 derivative (strictly signed), star invariant, C4/K4 regular, diamond monotone; Corollary 5.4

limitationTriage.limitation: Degree-tail proof exceptional set under-specified (adversarial audit M1).
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: State the discarded cliques explicitly and check the generic scores
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: E_L made explicit; verifier checks surviving cliques for beta=4,5 and the 43/36 regression

limitationTriage.limitation: Gem disagreement between reviewers (house only vs. gem at small damping).
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Exact census at order 5 plus a proof for the gem

limitationTriage.limitation: Census root counting on (0,1) misordered reversed isolation intervals and mishandled roots at 0 (post-revision audit R1, R2).
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Replace interval heuristics by exact Sturm counts on the requested open interval and regress against known roots
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: Sturm counter with endpoint roots divided out; regressions (two synthetic responses, Atlas 399, 256 known-root cases); census regenerated and compared with an independent Sturm implementation on all 33,900 coordinates (0 discrepancies)

limitationTriage.limitation: Reversed spread clause: whether unique extreme vertices suffice.
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Is there a graph with unique extrema for all mu whose spread increases?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: Numerical discovery scan, then exact certificate with positive-coefficient gap polynomials (Proposition 8.2)
